title: ConversationTurn
description: SPEC-01 (dev.md section 12, 'What exists today': 'conversation_turns is hub-internal while the conversation spec says robot turns sync through the hub: a shared turn record is a debt this item pays, because the signal has to live on it'). One completed turn, spec-shaped so the hub and the robot agree on its fields (backend/src/db/schema.ts's own conversationTurns table stays the hub's storage; this is the shape a sync payload and a fixture agree on, additive to what that table already carries - the fields this migration adds are signal, plan, subjects, outcomes typed, document, review_id and notice_ids; ACT-01 onward writes them, no writer yet). `signal` is required (ACT-01 computes it for every turn, package and command turns included, before routing); `plan`, `subjects`, `outcomes`, `document`, `review_id` and `notice_ids` stay null until the items that write them (ACT-03, CHAT-13, existing package handling, COMP-01, REVIEW-01, AGE-02) land.

args.description: The exact arguments the call was bound to.

user_message.description: Safe for the household; never a developer diagnostic.

person.description: Who spoke, captured at write time (a role can change later).

subjects.description: CHAT-13's stack of what the conversation is about, as it stood after this turn.

outcomes.description: The typed outcomes of every package call this turn ran, parked, or rejected. Null for a turn that proposed none.

document.description: COMP-01: a linked document this turn produced or referenced, when that exists. Null until COMP-01.

review_id.description: REVIEW-01's own TurnReview id, once one exists for this turn. Null until REVIEW-01.

notice_ids.description: AGE-02 (dev.md section 13 part 4, the outside review reconciled): the notification ids this turn raised, so a dedupe check and an audit trail both read the turn record rather than a separate index. Null until AGE-02.

speaker_evidence.description: What the body knows about who is speaking is evidence, typed on the turn.

present.description: The body's list of people with a fresh track or a fresh voice in the last thirty seconds, each at its own level.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock: wall_ms:counter:node (7.3), the same shape every other synced record type uses.
